samples.question: Three horizontal bars are shown: the REFERENCE bar at the top, and two candidate bars labeled A and B below. Every bar is split by a vertical boundary into a navy left part and a teal right part, but the bars have different total lengths. In the REFERENCE bar the navy part occupies a certain fraction of that bar's own length. Exactly one candidate bar is split at the same fraction of its own length as the REFERENCE; the other is split at a clearly different fraction. Which candidate, A or B, has the same left/right division as the REFERENCE? Answer A or B.
